definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating something is from abroad or outside.
Prefix indicating the outer or external aspect of something.

examples.japanese: {外車|がいしゃ}は{維持費|いじひ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Foreign cars have high maintenance costs.

examples.japanese: {外|がい}からの{圧力|あつりょく}に{屈|く}しない。
examples.english: I won't yield to outside pressure.

examples.japanese: {外来|がいらい}{語|ご}は{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Foreign loanwords are increasing every year.

notes:
{外|がい}〜 is a productive prefix meaning 'foreign' or 'outside.'

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {外国|がいこく} (foreign country)
- {外人|がいじん} (foreigner - informal)
- {外来|がいらい} (foreign-origin; outpatient)
- {外車|がいしゃ} (foreign car)
- {外科|げか} (surgery - medical department)
- {外交|がいこう} (diplomacy)
- {外見|がいけん} (outward appearance)
- {外出|がいしゅつ} (going out)
- {外食|がいしょく} (eating out)

ANTONYM PREFIX:
{内|ない}〜 (internal; inside)
